profile.headline: Staff AI Software Engineer at Okta
profile.summary: A software developer with more than 20 years of experience in developing various web, mobile and Windows applications in a wide variety of business applications.  Particularly interested in backend programming and efficient and complex relational database design using RDBMS and noSQL in cloud environment.   Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Developed strong communication and interpersonal skills while working in diverse team environments.  Security-minded software developer who maintains a better than working knowledge of all the latest web standards and practices and is constantly learning something new.

positions.title: Staff AI Software Engineer
positions.description:
Excited to join Okta as a Staff AI Software Engineer, where I'll be helping build autonomous digital workers for the enterprise.
I enjoy building AI products that solve real business problems through intelligent automation, agent orchestration, secure enterprise integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
What excites me most is creating systems that don't just answer questions, but can take action, work across different tools, and help people get meaningful work done in a secure and reliable way.

positions.title: Principal Systems Specialist
positions.description:
* Architected and secured multi-account AWS infrastructure (VPC, NAT, ALB/NLB, Step Functions, ECS/Fargate, EKS) supporting enterprise-scale AI workloads.

* Built CI/CD automation with GitHub Actions, CDK, and Terraform for zero-downtime deployments and multi-environment governance.

* Reduced AWS operational costs by over 30% through VPC endpoint optimization, traffic analysis, and compute utilization tuning.

* Designed, built, and successfully implemented scalable LLM infrastructure capable of processing multi-billion tokens monthly, fueling company growth from $0 to multi-million ARR in under two years.

* Designed and deployed AI-driven automation for lead discovery, enrichment, and hyper-personalized outreach.

* Built multi-provider AI orchestration (OpenAI, Azure AI, Google APIs) with dynamic routing for performance, resiliency, and cost efficiency.

* Strengthened security and compliance posture across the organization by implementing Vanta-driven evidence automation, continuous controls, and authoring company-wide development and security policies aligned with SOC 2 Type I/II, GDPR, and ISO 27001:2022 frameworks.

* Produced architectural documentation, security frameworks, and procedural guides adopted by engineering and compliance teams.

* Partnered cross-functionally with DevOps, product, and leadership teams to evaluate AI/ML platforms and ensure secure integrations.
positions.insights: Skills: English · Machine Learning · Large Language Models (LLM) · XML · Communication · Technical Leadership · Natural Language Processing (NLP)

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description: Skills: PostgreSQL · Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) · English · Coding Standards · Amazon Dynamodb · GraphQL · React Native · AWS Lambda · Amazon EC2 · Amazon S3 · AWS CloudFormation · Communication · Reliability · Technical Leadership · Microservices

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
* Offered architectural guidance and mentored team members to foster their professional growth and development.
* Conducted in-depth reviews of product requirements, technical designs, and implementation plans to ensure their clarity, effectiveness, and alignment with project objectives.
* Collaborated closely with other engineering leaders to identify opportunities and devise solutions to enhance overall engineering efficiency.
* Played an active role in the hiring process to recruit and expand the team, contributing to the growth and development of the organization.
* Optimized the backend architecture to minimize the company's expenses on AWS billing by employing various caching strategies in conjunction with database query optimization to reduce EC2/RDS costs.
* Developed an iOS social media application that achieved the top ranking in the Apple store for multiple weeks, surpassing industry leaders such as Facebook and TikTok.
* Created a sophisticated serverless architecture on AWS that superseded the outdated legacy monolith server.
* Developed automated push notifications to drive user engagement and boost retention rates within the application.
* Implemented various caching strategies to enhance the performance of multiple endpoints based on their respective use cases.
* Designed and developed a sophisticated Content Moderation System utilized by the internal team for moderating posted videos and in-app content.
* Created a fully manageable chat system with private, public, and group chat capabilities using AWS Websocket API and Redis with Node.js.
* Developed an iOS creator network app on a microservice architecture as a key member of a 15-person development team.

positions.title: Lead Web Developer
positions.description:
* Managed and mentored a team of developers and ensured quality and efficiency across the team’s work product and processes.
* Led the development of new and existing web projects for both in-house and external clients.
* Worked directly with the CEO and other team leads to ensure web project initiatives are aligned with business goals.
* Worked closely with designers to turn comps into interactive websites & experiences.
* Served as an internal expert on all things web development, mentored and shared knowledge with other team members.
* Improved code quality through writing unit tests, automation, and performing code reviews.
* Implemented a subscription-based community website to connect fitness trainers to guide users to meet their wellness goals.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
* Worked as a backend developer in a team to create various features of the Digital Asset Management System.
* Communicated and fulfilled requests from various clients from major film studios such as Marvel, Disney, Illumination, NBCU, WB and more.
* Analyzed complex data and developed innovative recommendations and solutions.
* Worked as a team for the development of the CORE asset management using RESTful APIs ensure all requirements are met with stability and security.
* Worked closely with engineering and project management to ensure effective communication and planning of key projects.
* Implemented Functional and Data Driven Testing for various REST services.
* Validated the database by executing SQL queries.
